clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Laris Geardawdle supplies empty containers for his ooze research. The jars are meant to hold pristine slime specimens gathered in the field.

Laris Geardawdle studies the strange biology of Azeroth's oozes. He found that slime creatures quickly take on the corruption around them, including tainted residues from Felwood. To study oozes in their natural state, he commissioned sturdy jars that can hold acidic specimens without harming them. The bag contains enough jars to collect clean slime in wild regions, especially Un'Goro Crater, where ancient glutinous oozes live free from demonic taint.
